[Bio]: My name is Dmitrii Zhukov. I am a game narrative designer and a published novelist. I build mystery-driven worlds and atmospheric horror. I create stories that ask the player to investigate the mysteries and make uneasy choices.

My first published novel, Myst, became the foundation for STATIC, a game concept that reimagines its story as a third-person mystery-horror adventure. This site is a presentation of that concept: the dialogue engine, the lore artifacts, the case files, and the documents.

[Career]: Before narrative design, I spent years in fintech as a Senior Technical Writer and Product Documentation Manager, owning documentation ecosystems end-to-end and working daily with engineering, QA, and support teams. Structuring complex information, keeping a hundred moving parts consistent, writing for a reader who is lost and needs to find their way — these are the same skills narrative systems are built with.

[Game writing]: Writing has been the core of my working life at every scale, from support instructions to leading a documentation team. Fiction has run alongside it the whole way.

STATIC is where the two finally meet: systems thinking from one career, storytelling from the other. Narrative design is where they stop being separate careers at all.

Influences

The stories I invent are shaped by curiosity and observation as much as by fiction. Inspiration comes from literature, cinema, video games, music, traveling, education. Visiting old castle ruins, listening to a history lecture, or hearing a clever turn of phrase in a song lyric often sparks new ideas: worlds, places, characters, narrative threads. I constantly collect fragments (atmosphere, dialogue pieces, symbolism, plot twists) and then reinterpret them into something new.

• Games: Bloodborne, Control, Alan Wake, The Last of Us, Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice, Death Stranding.

• Films: Drive, It Follows, Se7en, Arrival, Memento, Blade Runner 2049.

• Books: One Hundred Years of Solitude, Blood Meridian, Drood, Harry Potter, Ring, The Langoliers.

• Music: Poets of the Fall, STARSET, The Midnight, The National, Oh Hiroshima, Taylor Swift.

Every place I visit and every person I meet has a story waiting to be uncovered.
